description: Agent Team Studio: cross-platform desktop app for generating multi-agent team configuration from project requirements

status_legend.in_progress: 这个功能是当前唯一正在进行的任务。
status_legend.pass: 要求的验证已经通过，并且证据已经记录。

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a secure BrowserWindow with preload bridge and Chinese working UI.
features.evidence: Preload is bundled with esbuild for Electron sandbox; npm run dev launched Electron, 14 IPC handlers registered, BrowserWindow created, and no preload module error appeared.

features.name: Project Draft CRUD
features.description: Local project drafts can be created, saved, selected, and deleted.
features.evidence: ProjectService list/create/get/save/delete implemented; PersistenceService tests pass.

features.name: Requirement Analysis
features.description: Requirement text is validated and analyzed for goals, constraints, and the responsibility areas needed to complete it.
features.evidence: RequirementAnalyzer maps requirement signals to responsibility-area roles; Vitest coverage passes.

features.name: Local Team Generation
features.description: Local generation always includes Planner and Evaluator plus one or more Developer roles, derives responsibilities from the requirement instead of splitting work by implementation function, and creates an iteration-protocol workflow.
features.evidence: buildTeamConfig generates Planner, Evaluator, responsibility-driven Developer roles such as account/permissions and transaction/payment, plus RUP phases, iterations, and workflow steps for iteration protocol, development, evaluation/feedback, and acceptance; tests confirm mandatory roles and no frontend/backend function-split roles.

features.name: Mandatory Iteration Collaboration Workflow
features.description: Generated teams always contain Planner and Evaluator plus at least one Developer; every iteration starts with an iteration protocol, Developers build against it, Evaluator validates it against phase exit criteria and sends issues back to the responsible Developer.
features.evidence: Local generation emits Planner/Evaluator/Developer roles and iteration/evaluation workflow steps; normalizeTeamConfig reinserts missing mandatory roles and RUP workflow steps for LLM results; ProjectWriter writes iteration collaboration rules to AGENTS.team.md, each agents/*.md file, and appended AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md entries; tests cover local, LLM, and export paths.

features.name: RUP Process Management
features.description: TeamConfig schema v2 adds structured RUP process management with four phases, milestones, iterations, and exit criteria; old v1 drafts and sprint pointers migrate to the iteration protocol.
features.evidence: buildProcessManagement generates Inception/Elaboration/Construction/Transition phases and per-responsibility construction iterations; normalizeTeamConfig fills missing processManagement; ProjectService migrates v1 drafts; ProjectWriter migrates legacy sprint pointers; tests and benchmark validate schema v2; npm run dev launched Electron with BrowserWindow created and local generation observed.

features.name: Optional LLM Generation
features.description: OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible LLM can generate and normalize team JSON with local fallback.
features.evidence: LlmClient routes /chat/completions and /v1/messages; settings service persists protocol and encrypts API key; tests cover OpenAI, Anthropic, network failures, and local fallback.

features.name: Team Preview and Editing
features.description: Users can edit roles, workflow, RUP phases/iterations, and conventions before export.
features.evidence: TeamPreview renders editable role cards, workflow rows, ProcessManagementEditor phase/iteration fields, and convention fields.

features.name: Generation Decision Log
features.description: The UI shows why each responsibility area and role was generated.
features.evidence: TeamConfig includes generationLog entries with evidence/role/outcome; local, LLM, and fallback paths record concrete signal-to-role decisions; GenerationLog renders the process chain in the UI; tests assert role generation and LLM fallback entries.

features.name: Export AGENTS.team.md and agents.json
features.description: Generated team config is atomically written into a selected existing project directory as AGENTS.team.md, agents.json, and one Markdown file per agent under agents/, without overwriting existing AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md rules.
features.evidence: ProjectWriter tests cover AGENTS.team.md/agents.json create, per-agent agents/*.md create, AGENTS.team.md routing without duplicated role sections, overwrite confirmation, pointer append to AGENTS.md and/or CLAUDE.md without content loss, idempotent pointer append when both exist, and missing directory errors.

features.name: LLM Settings and Secret Storage
features.description: LLM provider protocol, settings, and encrypted API key storage are managed from the app.
features.evidence: SettingsService tests confirm protocol persistence/migration, encrypted storage, snapshot redaction, and key clearing.

features.name: Structured Logging
features.description: Services and IPC handlers emit structured JSON logs.
features.evidence: Logger and service logging points implemented; log output observed during tests.

features.name: Clean State Reset
features.description: Reset clears local app data without modifying target project files.
features.evidence: app:reset IPC calls persistence.resetAll and settingsService.reset; UI reset button implemented.

features.name: Benchmark Scripts
features.description: Benchmark measures local analysis, export, and validation performance.
features.evidence: scripts/benchmark.sh and benchmark.cjs implemented with numeric targets.

features.name: Cleanup Scanner
features.description: Scanner checks required harness files and stale artifacts.
features.evidence: scripts/cleanup-scanner.sh implemented and now checks for unbundled preload plus missing service/shared build outputs.

features.name: Cross-Platform Packaging
features.description: electron-builder configuration supports macOS and Windows targets; dist is generated locally and not tracked by Git.
features.evidence: npm run dist:mac and npm run dist:win locally build mac zip and Windows installers; dist/ is ignored and untracked; both asar archives include dist/services and dist/shared, and packaged preload only requires electron.

features.name: Core RUP Harness Generation
features.description: Writing a team into a project directory also initializes missing core harness files: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, session-handoff.md, init.sh, and docs/PROCESS.md, with RUP phase and iteration tracking.
features.evidence: ProjectWriter creates missing harness files while preserving existing state files; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md are initialized by default and existing rule files only receive pointer append; project-writer tests cover generated files, preservation, feature_list schema, RUP content, and init.sh executable mode.

features.name: Role and Harness Validation with Rule Maps
features.description: TeamConfig schema v3 adds stable role kinds; generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md become rule and agent maps; validation and auto-repair ensure AI agents can locate their role files without loading all roles.
features.evidence: TeamConfigValidator repairs missing required role kinds, duplicate IDs, dangling workflow/RUP references, and validates generated harness on disk; ProjectWriter blocks unfixable configs; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md map tests assert no operating-manual sections; schema v3 migration, LLM fallback, validator tests, benchmark, check, build, and cleanup scanner pass.

features.name: Export Quality Scoring Templates
features.description: Exporting a team initializes missing quality-document.md and evaluator-rubric.md as fillable quality scorecard and iteration review rubric, with pending grades and 0-2 review dimensions.
features.evidence: HarnessTemplates renders quality document and evaluator rubric from TeamConfig; ProjectWriter creates them only when missing; TeamConfigValidator validates generated scoring files; project-writer tests cover creation, content markers, and preservation of existing score files.

features.name: Harness Scoring Mechanism and Clean-State Checklist
features.description: Exported harness includes quality-document evidence sections, evaluator-rubric 1-5 scoring with Accept/Revise/Block and file assessment, plus clean-state-checklist.md.
features.evidence: HarnessTemplates renders quality evidence, 1-5 rubric, and clean-state checklist from TeamConfig; ProjectWriter initializes clean-state-checklist.md only when missing; TeamConfigValidator requires and validates the checklist marker; benchmark checks scoring markers; project-writer and validator tests cover creation, markers, and preservation.

features.name: Acceptance Hardening Fixes
features.description: Close scoring gaps before Accept: validate progress.md content on export, derive the transition feature from process management instead of hardcoded iteration IDs, and add LLM request timeouts.
features.evidence: npm run check passed; npm test 39 tests passed; npm run build passed; benchmark 3/3 with progress marker PASS; cleanup scanner CLEAN; tests cover progress.md marker rejection, custom transition iteration ID propagation, and LLM generation/connection timeouts.

features.name: Renderer Critical Workflow Smoke Tests
features.description: Automated renderer validation covers creating a draft, generating a team, editing roles, adding a custom role, selecting a target directory, validating, and exporting instead of relying only on manual verification.
features.evidence: npm test passed 43 tests; test/renderer-smoke.test.tsx exercises the renderer critical path with jsdom/Testing Library; test/ipc-channels.test.ts locks the documented 15 IPC channels; AGENT_TEAM_STUDIO_SMOKE=1 Electron smoke passed with isolated userData, verifying 15 IPC registrations, window load, generation, export, and harness validation.
